# Skyline Dental Bend

> Award-winning family and cosmetic dentistry practice in Bend, Oregon, offering comprehensive dental care from preventive services to oral surgery.

Skyline Dental has been serving the Bend, Oregon community since 1974 with a team of experienced dentists including Dr. Salari, Dr. Zack Porter, Dr. Maureen Porter, and other specialists. The practice emphasizes preventive care, emergency services, and advanced restorative dentistry using modern technology.

## Comprehensive Dentistry Services

- [Comprehensive Dentistry](https://skylinedentalbend.com/services/comprehensive-dentistry): Family dentistry services: exams, cleanings, root canals, dentures
- [Comprehensive Dental Exam & Consultation](https://skylinedentalbend.com/services/comprehensive-dentistry/comprehensive-exam-consultation): Comprehensive exam, consultation, TMJ evaluation, cancer screening
- [Dental Cleanings](https://skylinedentalbend.com/services/comprehensive-dentistry/dental-cleanings): Professional dental cleanings with scaling and polishing
- [Root Canal Therapy](https://skylinedentalbend.com/services/comprehensive-dentistry/root-canal-therapy): Root canal therapy for tooth infections and pain relief
- [Full & Partial Dentures](https://skylinedentalbend.com/services/comprehensive-dentistry/full-partial-dentures): Full and partial dentures for missing teeth replacement

## Preventive & Diagnostic Services

- [Oral Cancer Screening](https://skylinedentalbend.com/services/comprehensive-dentistry/oral-cancer-screening): Oral cancer screening & early detection with HPV-16 testing
- [Low Radiation Digital X-Rays](https://skylinedentalbend.com/services/comprehensive-dentistry/low-radiation-digital-x-rays): Low-radiation digital x-rays for precise dental diagnosis
- [Fluoride Treatment](https://skylinedentalbend.com/services/comprehensive-dentistry/fluoride-treatment): Fluoride & fluoride varnish treatment for cavity prevention
- [Sealants](https://skylinedentalbend.com/services/comprehensive-dentistry/sealants): Dental sealants for cavity prevention and oral health
- [Periodontal (Gum) Disease](https://skylinedentalbend.com/services/comprehensive-dentistry/periodontal-gum-disease): Gum disease treatment including Arestin antibiotic therapy

## Emergency & Restorative Services

- [Emergency Services](https://skylinedentalbend.com/services/emergency-services): Emergency dental services: same-day appointments for urgent care
- [Fix Chipped or Broken Tooth](https://skylinedentalbend.com/services/emergency-services/broken-tooth): Chipped/broken tooth repair with bonding, veneers, implants
- [Decrease Pain or Swelling in Mouth](https://skylinedentalbend.com/services/emergency-services/pain-or-swelling): Emergency pain relief and mouth swelling treatment options
- [Loose Filling](https://skylinedentalbend.com/services/emergency-services/loose-filling): Loose filling repair and restorative dentistry solutions
- [Dental Trauma](https://skylinedentalbend.com/services/emergency-services/dental-trauma): Dental trauma treatment from sports injuries and accidents

## Surgical Services

- [Oral Surgery](https://skylinedentalbend.com/services/o-surgery): Oral surgery: tooth extraction, wisdom teeth, bone grafting
